en: Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a posed studio-style photograph of an African chief and his entourage. The central seated figure wears a dark jacket and traditional striped cloth, surrounded by men and women in wraps, beads, and head coverings. Several drums and other objects are placed in front of them. The card has a printed border, worn edges, and Portuguese captions at the bottom.
